fields.climate: tropical maritime; hot, humid, cloudy; prolonged rainy season (May to January), short dry season (January to May)
fields.terrain: interior mostly steep, rugged mountains with dissected, upland plains; coastal plains with rolling hills
fields.hazards: occasional severe storms and forest fires in the Darien area
fields.farm: sugarcane, rice, bananas, oranges, oil palm fruit, chicken, plantains, maize, milk, pineapples
fields.exports: copper ore, ships, refined petroleum, bananas, fish
fields.industries: construction, brewing, cement and other construction materials, sugar milling

fields.legal: civil law system; Supreme Court of Justice reviews legislative acts
